name: world.aprs/aprs-world
title: APRS World
description: Live amateur-radio APRS data: stations, tracks, weather, telemetry, packets and nets (read-only).

tools.name: get_station
tools.description: Returns the latest known state of one APRS station by callsign: last heard time, last reported position (WGS84 latitude/longitude), altitude (m), speed (km/h), course (degrees), station type, symbol, comment, digipeater path, device model when identifiable, packet count and first-heard time. Answers questions such as where an amateur-radio callsign is, whether it is on the air, or what it beacons. If the callsign has no exact match, the most recently heard SSID of the same operator is returned. Read-only; data is public APRS-IS traffic.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: get_station_track
tools.description: Returns the recorded position history of one APRS station for the last 1–48 hours, oldest first: time (UTC), latitude/longitude (WGS84), altitude (m), speed (km/h) and course (degrees). Long histories are thinned evenly to at most the requested number of points, always keeping the first and the last. If nothing was recorded in the window, the most recent older points still held are returned and marked as older. Stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) return no history.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read the history, in hours (1–48, default 6).

max_points.description: Maximum number of track points to return (1–200, default 100).

tools.name: find_stations_near_station
tools.description: Finds APRS stations heard recently within a radius (10–200 km) of the last reported position of another station given by callsign. Returns each station with callsign, type, distance (km), position (WGS84), last-heard time (UTC), speed (km/h) and comment, nearest first, excluding the centre station itself. Only stations heard within the last 30 minutes (infrastructure such as digipeaters, iGates, weather stations and objects: 24 hours) are included. The centre station must have a known position.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

radius_km.description: Search radius around the station in kilometres (10–200, default 50).

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (1–50, default 25).

tools.name: get_station_weather
tools.description: Returns weather reports sent by an APRS weather station for the last 1–48 hours: temperature (°C), humidity (%), pressure (hPa), wind direction (degrees), wind speed and gust (m/s), rain in the last hour and 24 hours (mm). Gives the latest report in full, minimum/maximum over the window for the main values, and an evenly thinned series (at most 48 points). Stations that do not send weather return an empty result.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read weather reports, in hours (1–48, default 6).

tools.name: get_station_telemetry
tools.description: Returns APRS telemetry of one station for the last 1–48 hours: up to five analog channels (already converted with the station's own calibration equations) and 8 digital bits per sample, with channel names, units and bit labels when the station published them. Evenly thinned to at most 48 samples. Stations without published calibration return an empty result.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

hours.description: How far back to read telemetry, in hours (1–48, default 24).

tools.name: get_station_raw_packets
tools.description: Returns the most recent raw APRS packets (TNC2 text as received from APRS-IS) sent by one callsign, newest first, with the time each was received (UTC). Packet text is written by the station and returned unmodified apart from control characters and a 512-character cap per packet. The backend keeps raw packets for about 24 hours. Stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) return no packets, and any single packet carrying the marker is left out.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of packets to return (1–50, default 20).

tools.name: get_station_reception
tools.description: Summarises, for the last 24 hours, which APRS-IS gateways (iGates) with a known position received one station: the number of distinct iGates, the farthest iGate and its distance (km), and the same for the most recent transmission. Distances are great-circle kilometres between the station's position at transmit time and the iGate. For stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) only the iGate count is returned: the distances come from the station's past positions.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Searches stations by callsign prefix and, for terms of 4 or more characters, by words in the station's beacon comment (for example a locality or club name typed by the operator). Returns up to 25 matches with callsign, type, position (WGS84), comment and last-heard time (UTC); exact callsign matches come first, then most recently heard.

query.description: Callsign prefix or short comment word, 4–9 characters: letters, digits and . / + - only.

tools.name: get_turkish_aprs_net
tools.description: Returns the schedule published on aprs.world for the Turkish APRS on-the-air net ("APRS Çevrimi"): whether it is active, title, day of week, local time and time zone, frequency, coordinator callsign, description, next session time (UTC) and the last session summary. The text fields are entered by the net coordinator.

tools.name: list_aprs_thursday_participants
tools.description: Lists the stations that checked in to the weekly APRS Thursday net on a UTC date, grouped by country, with totals. The counting window is that Thursday 00:00 UTC minus 6 h to the next day 00:00 UTC plus 6 h, one station per callsign-SSID. Defaults to today (UTC). At most 25 callsigns are listed per country; counts are complete.

date.description: UTC date of the net, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).
